# Beckett House Montessori

> Beckett House is a second-generation, family-run Montessori nursery with two North London settings. The nurseries provide calm, child-led early years education alongside the Early Years Foundation Stage.

Canonical website: https://www.beckett-house.co.uk/
Information reviewed: 30 September 2026

## Nursery locations

- [Angel Montessori nursery](https://www.beckett-house.co.uk/angel): 98 Richmond Avenue, Barnsbury, Islington, London N1 0LL. For children aged 2 to 5. Open Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm, 48 weeks a year. Mornings 8am to 1pm, afternoons 1pm to 6pm. Telephone 020 7278 8824. Email info@beckett-house.co.uk.
- [Abbey Road Montessori nursery](https://www.beckett-house.co.uk/abbey-road): Abbey Hive, 84–86 Abbey Road, St John's Wood, London NW8 0QA. For babies and children from 3 months to 5 years. Open Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm, 50 weeks a year. Mornings 8am to 1pm, afternoons 1pm to 6pm. Telephone 020 4568 7042. Email abbeyroad@beckett-house.co.uk.

## Key facts

- Beckett House was founded in Angel in 1996.
- The nursery is family-run and MEAB Montessori accredited.
- Both settings offer home-cooked food and eligible funded childcare hours (15 or 30 hours).
- Angel is a mixed-age Montessori preschool.
- Abbey Road has dedicated baby, toddler and preschool rooms, and opened in summer 2026.
- A £75 registration fee applies to privately paid places; a deposit of four weeks' fees secures a place. Registration is not enrolment.
- Current availability, fees and funding arrangements should always be confirmed directly with the nursery team.
